/-- A key block at a vertex whose value mask is `false` is unchanged by relabeling.
This preserves unused key blocks when their value masks are set to `false`. -/
theorem relabel_key_fixed (S n : ℕ) (values : Fin S → Bool)
    (rows : Fin S → Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) (mask : Fin S → Fin 2 → Bool)
    (r : Fin (10 * S * n + 2 * S) → Bool) (b : Bool) (v : Fin S) (t : Fin n)
    (hv : values v = false) :
    (List.ofFn (relabel S n values rows mask r)).getD ((b.toNat * S + v) * n + t) false =
      (List.ofFn r).getD ((b.toNat * S + v) * n + t) false := by
  rw [relabel_key_getD, hv, Bool.xor_false]

  rw [tableWith_eq, tableWith_eq]

theorem outputBit_first_unchanged (C : DAGCircuit inputs) (v : ℕ → Bool)
    (cutoff : ℕ) (i : Fin C.gates.length) (a : Fin (C.gates[i]).args.length → Bool)
    (h : (i : ℕ) ≠ cutoff ∨ (List.ofFn a).getD 0 false = false) :
    outputBit C v cutoff 0 i a = outputBit C v cutoff 1 i a := by
  rcases h with hi | ha
  · simp only [outputBit_eq, hi, false_and, or_false]
  · simp only [outputBit_eq, ha, Bool.false_eq_true, and_false, or_false]

/-- The original output-key pair at `w` is the relabeled pair with its two
entries swapped exactly when `v w = true`. This also holds for default keys
outside `C.size`. -/
theorem output_pair_relabel {m : ℕ} (C : DAGCircuit m) (v : ℕ → Bool)
    {K ρ : Type} [Inhabited K] (s : GarbleSeed C K ρ) (w : ℕ) :
    (keyAt C s w false, keyAt C s w true) =
      if v w then
        (keyAt C (relabelSeed C v s) w true, keyAt C (relabelSeed C v s) w false)
      else (keyAt C (relabelSeed C v s) w false, keyAt C (relabelSeed C v s) w true) := by
  cases hv : v w <;> simp [hv, keyAt_relabel]
